title: Dari buah ke cangkirmu
visual_prompt: Original colourful cartoon explainer for Gen Z. Lavender/lime fruit entrance and yellow cutaway; mint processing/drying diagram; coral roasting with changing beans; lavender moving burr diagram with falling grounds; sky-blue pour-over with grounds retained in the dripper and rising coffee in the cup; mint practical close showing two brewing tools. Camera, movement, arrows and short labels explain each step. Complete original EGON logo is composed separately, unchanged and profile-managed. No dark studio mascot, reference artwork, laboratory claim or product specification.
